_note: Clinical services and departments from pdh.com.ph/our-services (crawled 25 Nov 2026). 'offered' lists come from each service's own page. 'preparation' is NOT on the current site: every entry is a labeled sample. 'doctorMatch' maps a service to doctor departments/specializations in doctors.json. A null location or hours means the current site shows TBD.

services.name: Emergency Room (ER)
services.summary: Open 24/7, staffed by experienced professionals for all emergency needs.

services.name: Radiology
services.summary: Provides essential imaging services such as X-rays, CT scans, and ultrasounds, for accurate diagnoses.
services.preparation: Bring your doctor’s request form and a valid ID. Some scans require fasting; the Radiology desk will tell you when you book.

services.name: Laboratory
services.summary: Offers diagnostic tests, including blood works and specialized tests, to provide accurate diagnosis and support treatment.
services.detail: Our laboratory is fully equipped to conduct a wide range of diagnostic tests, including hematology, clinical microscopy, clinical chemistry, microbiology, immunology, and serology. The laboratory staff ensures quick and accurate results, which are essential for effective treatment planning.
offered: Hematology (Blood & Cell Analysis): CBC w/ Platelet, ESR, CT/BT, PT/PTT, Reticulocyte Count, Malarial Smear, Peripheral Blood Smear
Microbiology (Infection Detection): AFB Stain, Gram Stain & KOH Smear, Culture & Sensitivity (Blood, Urine, Stool, CSF, Sputum, Swab/Discharge)
services.preparation: Bring your doctor’s request form and a valid ID. Fasting tests (such as blood sugar and lipid profile) need 8–10 hours without food; water is allowed.

services.name: Nuclear Medicine
services.summary: The only Nuclear Medicine Department in Parañaque—bringing advanced diagnostic and therapeutic care closer to the community.
services.detail: Our Nuclear Medicine services specializes in using small amounts of radioactive materials for diagnostic and therapeutic purposes.
services.preparation: Book ahead; this department is by appointment only. Your doctor may ask you to pause thyroid medication before an uptake study.

services.name: Multi-Diagnostic Center
services.summary: Advanced testing in cardiology, vascular, and neurology using ECG, Echocardiograms, EEG, and other cutting-edge tools.
services.hours: Echo: Mon–Fri 7 AM – 5 PM, Sat–Sun 7 AM – 4 PM. Stress Echo: Saturday, by appointment. Vascular: Mon–Fri, by appointment.
offered: Cardiology: Electrocardiogram (ECG), Treadmill Stress Test, 24-Hour Holter Monitor, 24-Hour BP Monitor, 2D Echocardiogram with Doppler, Stress Echocardiogram
Vascular: Carotid/Vertebral Duplex Scanning, Peripheral Arterial and Venous Duplex Scanning, Transcranial Doppler Study, Venous Compression Study, Saphenous Vein Mapping
Neuroscience: Electroencephalogram (EEG), Cranial Ultrasound (Pediatrics), Electromyography (EMG), Nerve Conduction Velocity (NCV)
services.preparation: Bring your doctor’s request form. Wear comfortable clothes and shoes for a treadmill stress test, and avoid caffeine on the day.

services.name: Pulmonary
services.summary: We provide expert services for respiratory conditions.
services.detail: We offer procedures designed to address respiratory conditions and support patients through accurate diagnoses for healthier lungs.
services.hours: 6 AM – 10 PM (Monday to Friday), 6 AM – 6 PM (Saturdays & Sundays including Holidays)
services.preparation: Bring your doctor’s request form. For a pulmonary function test, avoid heavy meals and smoking beforehand.

services.name: Hemodialysis Center
services.summary: Essential dialysis treatment for patients with kidney disease, ensuring quality renal care.
services.hours: 6 AM – 10 PM (Monday, Wednesday, Friday), 6 AM – 6 PM (Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday)
services.preparation: Bring your nephrologist’s dialysis order, recent lab results, and your PhilHealth or HMO documents for coverage.

services.name: Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation
services.summary: Modern technology and therapy programs designed to support faster recovery and improved functionality.
services.detail: Services include Physical Therapy, Occupational Therapy, and other Rehabilitation Programs to help patients regain functionality and improve their quality of life.
offered: Physical Therapy: Electrotherapy & Ultrasound Therapy, Transcutaneous/Electrical Nerve Stimulation, Traction Machines, Infrared Radiation & Hydrotherapy, Manual Therapy & Exercise/Gym Equipment
Occupational Therapy: Adult & Pediatric Management, Dysphagia Management, Activities of Daily Living (ADL)
services.preparation: Bring your doctor’s referral. Wear loose clothing you can move in.

services.name: Operating Room (OR)
services.summary: Our OR is equipped to support a wide array of surgical procedures. Led by our expert medical team, we provide cutting-edge techniques and unmatched surgical precision.
services.preparation: Your surgeon and anesthesiologist will give you fasting and medication instructions before any scheduled procedure.

services.name: ICU (Intensive Care Unit)
services.summary: Expert critical care and monitoring for adults with life-threatening conditions.

services.name: NICU (Neonatal Intensive Care Unit)
services.summary: Specialized care and intensive monitoring for premature and critically ill newborns, ensuring the best outcomes.

services.name: PICU (Pediatric Intensive Care Unit)
services.summary: Expert care for children with severe or critical conditions, offering specialized pediatric treatment.

services.name: Outpatient Department (OPD) Clinics
services.summary: Venue for your health consultations with your trusted doctors.
services.preparation: Check your doctor’s clinic schedule on their profile, then call to book. Bring previous results and a list of your medications.

services.name: OB Ultrasound Services
services.summary: Advanced imaging to monitor maternal and fetal health, ensuring safe pregnancies and informed care.
services.preparation: Bring your OB’s request. For a transabdominal scan early in pregnancy you may be asked to come with a full bladder.

services.name: Breastfeeding Station
services.summary: A comfortable and safe space for mothers to breastfeed their infants.

services.name: Animal Bite Center
services.summary: Provides pre and post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) for animal bites.
services.preparation: Wash the wound with soap and running water for 15 minutes, then come in as soon as possible.

services.name: Eye Center
services.summary: Equipped to handle a variety of eye-related health concerns, including common and specialized eye diseases.
offered: Diagnosis and Treatment of Eye Diseases
services.preparation: Bring your current glasses or contact lens prescription. If your pupils will be dilated, bring someone to drive you home.

services.name: Dental Services
services.summary: Comprehensive dental care, offering expert treatments to maintain oral health and confident smiles.
services.preparation: Brush before your visit and bring a list of any medications you take.

services.name: Pharmacy
services.summary: Convenience and easy access to essential medications, ensuring your needs are met promptly.
services.preparation: Bring your prescription. Senior citizen and PWD IDs are needed for statutory discounts.

services.name: Admitting Department
services.summary: A seamless and efficient admission process, ensuring a smooth experience for patients and their families.
services.preparation: Bring a valid ID, your admitting order, and PhilHealth or HMO documents.

services.name: Chemo Infusion Center
services.summary: Serves both inpatients and outpatients, offering safe, personalized chemotherapy treatments in a caring and comfortable setting.

services.name: Medical Records
services.summary: Secure and organized access to medical records, ensuring patients and healthcare providers receive timely and accurate information.
services.preparation: Bring a valid ID; an authorization letter is needed if you are requesting records for someone else.

services.name: Patient Experience Department
services.summary: Dedicated to enhancing patient satisfaction, our team ensures compassionate care, clear communication, and a positive hospital journey.

specialtyGroups.name: Internal Medicine
specialtyGroups.blurb: Cardiology, pulmonology, nephrology, neurology, endocrinology, gastroenterology, oncology, infectious diseases and more.

specialtyGroups.name: Pediatrics
specialtyGroups.blurb: Well-baby and sick-child care, immunizations and newborn screening.

specialtyGroups.name: Obstetrics & Gynecology
specialtyGroups.blurb: Prenatal care, delivery, sonology and women’s health.

specialtyGroups.name: Surgery
specialtyGroups.blurb: General, orthopedic, neuro, thoracic and vascular surgery; urology.

specialtyGroups.name: ENT, Eye & Dental
specialtyGroups.blurb: Ear, nose and throat; eye center; dental services.
